features.statement: Page uses a single sans-serif family (Helvetica Neue-style) for all text, including headings.
Body text is set at a comfortable 16px size with roomy 24px line height.
Hero h1 is very large (about 64px) and set as a multi-line uppercase tagline.
Small labels, eyebrows, nav items, links and section headings use tracked, letterspaced uppercase text.
Proper heading hierarchy: h2 for sections, h3 for card titles, h4 for sub-groups.
Minimal semantic DOM with single header, main, nav, footer and few divs, and no article or aside wrappers.
Page is lean: one script, no external stylesheets, few meta tags, few unique classes, almost no inline styles.
Meaningful descriptive alt text is provided on featured content images.
Layout built with flexbox and CSS grid throughout.
Single full-width content column with no sidebar.
Secondary items are shown in a uniform multi-column grid of equal-sized vertical cards.
Featured item is a split card: image on one side, text panel with eyebrow, title, date and link on the other.
Text and images occupy separate regions; titles sit beneath images without overlays, truncation or overlap.
Partner logos are arranged in a dense multi-column grid, each on its own tile.
Footer is compact, with links inline at the side and a small logo above the copyright line.
Dark cool blue-black page background with a single dark card color and white tiles.
Single saturated red accent color for links, labels and highlights, with grey secondary text.
Key info such as event dates is highlighted in a solid accent-colored block.
Every card has a red uppercase 'READ MORE →' text link with an arrow.
Every news item displays a date, including the featured story.
Social buttons are rectangular outlined buttons with accent-colored borders and uppercase labels in a full-width band.
Navigation bar is semi-transparent with backdrop blur, with a compact logo and labelled 'Menu' toggle button.
Navigation lists many uppercase white items in the top bar.
Logo or partner tiles have small rounded corners; buttons have modest 4px radius.
Featured tag is a plain accent-colored text label rather than a filled badge.
Full-width accent-colored horizontal rules separate major sections, and hairlines follow section headings.
Flat styling: no shadows, animations or transforms; cards are defined by thin 1px borders.
Hero has a faded, dim diagonal stripe graphic behind the headline.
Logos are served at 2x resolution and repeated in nav and hero.
Light logos placed on white tiles become nearly invisible; some tiles fall back to plain text.
Sections are introduced with short uppercase headings such as 'LATEST NEWS' and 'OUR PARTNERS'.
Hero adds a location line beneath the headline, alongside a short tagline.
Document title uses a pipe separator and typographic curly apostrophes.
News headlines are shown in full, untruncated.
